title: folkehelseinstituttet/hcvtyper pipeline parameters
description: Assemble and genotype HCV genomes from NGS data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

skip_contamination_check.description: Skip the cross-sample contamination check based on all-vs-all BLAST of assembled contigs.

contamination_min_length.description: Minimum contig length (bp) to include in the cross-sample contamination BLAST.

contamination_min_id.description: Minimum BLAST percent identity to flag a cross-sample contamination hit.

denovo_min_contig_length.description: Minimum contig length (bp) to count as substantial de novo evidence. Set to 500 (Phase 10 D-02 validation: 500 keeps genuine short minor contigs such as ERR1810507 829bp/30x/92%); effective runtime value comes from nextflow.config.

denovo_min_kmer_cov.description: Minimum SPAdes k-mer coverage for a contig to count as de novo evidence. Reconciled to the validated 2.0 (Phase 8 D-10): the prior 10.0 was stricter than validated and would wrongly refute genuine partial contigs (e.g. ERR1810453's 2b at k-mer cov ~5) that CLASS-02 must preserve.

denovo_min_blast_identity.description: Minimum BLAST percent identity for a contig hit to confirm a minor strain. Consumed by the Phase 3 de novo confirmation logic (declared/inert in Phase 2).

denovo_match_level.description: Level at which de novo evidence must match a candidate minor strain. Consumed by the Phase 3 de novo confirmation logic (declared/inert in Phase 2).

denovo_confirm_minor.description: Require orthogonal de novo/BLAST evidence before reporting a minor strain. Consumed by the Phase 3 de novo confirmation logic (declared/inert in Phase 2).

rescue_min_length.description: Minimum de novo contig length (bp) required before a de novo subtype may replace a mismatched mapped candidate (Phase 10 rescue, D-02). Compared with strict greater-than.

rescue_min_pident.description: Minimum BLAST percent identity of the de novo top hit required to trigger a subtype rescue (Phase 10, D-02). Compared with strict greater-than.

rescue_min_aln_length.description: Minimum BLAST alignment length (bp) of the de novo top hit required to trigger a subtype rescue (Phase 10, D-02). Compared with greater-than-or-equal.

rescue_min_kmer_cov.description: Minimum SPAdes k-mer coverage of the de novo contig required to trigger a subtype rescue (Phase 10, D-02). Compared with greater-than-or-equal.

rescue_1a1b_length.description: Stricter contig-length floor (bp) applied when both the mapped candidate and the de novo top-hit subtypes are in {1a, 1b}, where the 1a/1b boundary is hard to call from short contigs (Phase 10, D-04).

n_candidates.description: Number of neutrally-ranked candidate references to select and map (cand_1..cand_n). Default 2 reproduces the legacy two-slot topology under the compatibility shim. Capped at 2 until the Phase 9 filename-slot migration (COMPAT-02) adds N-slot output; values >2 would silently map later candidates to the wrong reference.

score_weight_evenness.description: Weight on the CV-evenness factor in the Phase 8 dominance score (SCORE-02 / D-02). This is the DOMINANT term and must exceed score_weight_reads so a spiky high-read cross-mapping artefact loses to a genuine even minor.

score_weight_reads.description: Weight on log10(candidate reads) in the Phase 8 dominance score (D-02). Read counts alone are contamination-prone, so this is kept below score_weight_evenness.

score_weight_kmercov.description: Weight on the bonus-only log(k-mer coverage) term in the Phase 8 dominance score (D-05). Contributes only positively; missing/none assembly support yields no boost and never a penalty.

score_evenness_k.description: Evenness-transform constant in the Phase 8 dominance score: the CV-evenness factor is 1/(1 + score_evenness_k * CV) over per-position depth including zeros (D-03).

contamination_min_dir_ratio.description: Minimum source/recipient coverage ratio for a contamination direction to be reported.

contamination_genome_size.description: Expected viral genome size (bp), used for the index-hop threshold.

contamination_kmer_size.description: SPAdes final k-mer size; used to convert k-mer coverage to read depth (150 bp reads, k=127, multiplier=24).

contamination_min_aln_cov.description: Minimum fraction of the shorter contig that must be covered by the BLAST alignment.
